description: One self-sufficient work order for an incident on a node (ADR-221): the incident fused with its root-cause chain, blast radius, governing policies, and node divergence — each claim provenance-stamped, so you can act without grepping. Give a node id (a service, file, or symbol); omit errorId for the node's most-recent incident, or pass errorId to pin one.

errorId.description: Pin a specific incident by its id; omit for the most recent

nodeId.description: Graph node id the incident is on (service/file/symbol)

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_incident_card
